title: fix: count streamed chat session tokens
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16428

- Counts provider-reported usage events in streamed chat sessions using the existing `streamSSE` callback.
- Corrects `/exit` totals: two replies reporting 7 tokens each now show 14 instead of 0.
- Adds one regression to the existing chat tests. No request or model-selection changes.
- Verified: all 284 CLI tests, build and scoped Biome; native Commander/readline totals 7/14/0. Also applies cleanly with the separate default-banner fix.

Strict TypeScript diagnostics remain identical to the 36 existing baseline errors. Local tests used the already installed dependency cache.

gist.headline: The tokens add up
gist.blurb: Polli CLI keeps count while streamed chat replies arrive. Two seven-token replies make fourteen at /exit, as arithmetic intended.
gist.summary: Polli CLI counts provider-reported usage events during streamed chat sessions, correcting /exit totals from 0 to 14 for two replies reporting 7 tokens each.
gist.impact: People using streamed chat get an accurate session token total at /exit, with no change to requests or model selection.
gist.visual_concept: Show Polli checking a cozy retro terminal where two streamed chat replies, each marked 7, feed into a session counter marked 14. A small code-plant grows beside the terminal; the scene makes the corrected arithmetic immediately readable.
